verdict.rationale: smolagents exposes `final_answer_checks`, a list of validation functions run before accepting a final answer, which acts as an output guardrail, and step callbacks that can transform agent memory mid-run [smolagents-docs-19][smolagents-docs-16]. However there is no documented input-guardrail mechanism (e.g., pre-execution content filtering) or built-in blocking/transforming of unsafe user input beyond sandboxed code execution restrictions. Missing for 10: dedicated input validation/guardrail API, examples of blocking unsafe content, and independent evidence of guardrail effectiveness.
